item.title: World’s First Native 4K Video Model
item.description: Kling AI rolled out the world’s first native 4K video generation function via its Kling 3.0 model on April 23. It supports one-click true 4K video creation with superior visual effects and higher efficiency, and has been widely applied in film, advertising and various creative fields by professional teams and individual creators.
